title: Bridge fixture
tagline: A tiny test game for the bridge.
teaser: Start a round, win or lose it, unlock a package and leave by every door. It exists so the Hall can prove hosted games work end to end.

manPage.synopsis: fixture — start a round, then win, lose or leave.
manPage.description: A plain HTML and JavaScript game that loads the classic bridge build with one script tag. Used by the end-to-end tests; never listed in the Hall.

packages.title: Winning round
packages.description: Win a round of the fixture.
